name: JTBD1 — Stale content edge case, graceful empty
description: Edge-case case. Requires ADMIN_TOOLS_ENABLED=true and site-admin PAT. Model queries query-admin-insights (kind=stale-content) with an extreme minAgeDays 3650 (~10 years). No content is that old, so the correct result is a graceful empty set (totalStaleItems 0, no rows) with no crash or error. Read-only.
prompt: Which content on this site is stale past 3650 days (about 10 years)? Use the Admin Insights stale-content view with that threshold. If nothing qualifies, say so plainly. Do not modify or delete anything.
